name: RationalNumber
doc:
有理数（GMP `mpq_t` 的抽象模型）：分子 / 分母 + 分母非零证据。
    **重建**（上游定义丢失）。
stmt:
structure RationalNumber where
            
  num : ℤ
            
  den : ℕ
              
  den_pos : 0 < den
  deriving DecidableEq

name: QuadraticNumber
doc: 二次根式数 `a + b√n`（`ℚ(√n)` 基）。**重建**。
stmt:
structure QuadraticNumber where
              
  a : RationalNumber
              
  b : RationalNumber
                     
  n : ℕ
  deriving DecidableEq

name: AlgebraicNumber
doc: 代数数（极小多项式 + 隔离区间）。**重建**。
stmt:
structure AlgebraicNumber where
                 
  minimalPoly : List ℤ
                
  lower : ℚ
                
  upper : ℚ
  deriving DecidableEq

name: TranscendentalNumber
doc: 超越数（`π`、`e` 及其有理倍）。**重建**。
stmt:
structure TranscendentalNumber where
                             
  name : String
              
  coeff : ℚ
  deriving DecidableEq

name: SymbolicType
doc:
符号数类型枚举。来源 `SymbolicType`。
    按包含性排序：`rational < quadratic < algebraic < transcendental`。
stmt:
inductive SymbolicType where
  | rational
  | quadratic
  | algebraic
  | transcendental
  deriving DecidableEq

                                       
                                                                  
                           

                                                              
instance : LinearOrder SymbolicType
proof:
LinearOrder.lift'
    (fun t => match t with
      | .rational => (0 : ℕ) | .quadratic => 1 | .algebraic => 2 | .transcendental => 3)
    (by
      intro a b h
      cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all)

name: SymbolicType.promote
doc: 类型提升：取较大类型（来源 `SymbolicType.promote`）。
stmt: def SymbolicType.promote (a b : SymbolicType) : SymbolicType
proof: max a b

name: promote_ge_left
doc: **(A)** 提升结果 ≥ 左操作数。
stmt: theorem promote_ge_left (a b : SymbolicType) : a ≤ SymbolicType.promote a b
proof: le_max_left a b

name: promote_ge_right
doc: **(A)** 提升结果 ≥ 右操作数。
stmt: theorem promote_ge_right (a b : SymbolicType) : b ≤ SymbolicType.promote a b
proof: le_max_right a b

name: promote_assoc
doc: **(A)** 提升满足结合律。
stmt:
theorem promote_assoc (a b c : SymbolicType) :
    SymbolicType.promote (SymbolicType.promote a b) c =
      SymbolicType.promote a (SymbolicType.promote b c)
proof: max_assoc a b c

name: promote_comm
doc: **(A)** 提升满足交换律。
stmt:
theorem promote_comm (a b : SymbolicType) :
    SymbolicType.promote a b = SymbolicType.promote b a
proof: max_comm a b

name: promotionTable
doc: 16 种类型组合的提升表（来源 `promotionTable`）。
stmt: def promotionTable : List (SymbolicType × SymbolicType × SymbolicType)
proof:
[(.rational, .rational, .rational),
   (.rational, .quadratic, .quadratic),
   (.rational, .algebraic, .algebraic),
   (.rational, .transcendental, .transcendental),
   (.quadratic, .rational, .quadratic),
   (.quadratic, .quadratic, .quadratic),
   (.quadratic, .algebraic, .algebraic),
   (.quadratic, .transcendental, .transcendental),
   (.algebraic, .rational, .algebraic),
   (.algebraic, .quadratic, .algebraic),
   (.algebraic, .algebraic, .algebraic),
   (.algebraic, .transcendental, .transcendental),
   (.transcendental, .rational, .transcendental),
   (.transcendental, .quadratic, .transcendental),
   (.transcendental, .algebraic, .transcendental),
   (.transcendental, .transcendental, .transcendental)]

name: promotion_table_correct
doc:
**(A)** 提升表对任意条目组合恰有一条记录（表是函数且完备）。
    对四个构造子两两穷尽即可（`cases` 展开 16 种组合，各自 `decide`）。
stmt:
theorem promotion_table_correct (t1 t2 : SymbolicType) :
    (promotionTable.filter (fun x => x.1 = t1 && x.2.1 = t2)).length = 1
proof:
by
  cases t1 <;> cases t2 <;> decide

name: SymbolicCoord
doc: 符号坐标联合体。来源 `SymbolicCoord`。
stmt:
inductive SymbolicCoord where
  | ofRational (r : RationalNumber)
  | ofQuadratic (q : QuadraticNumber)
  | ofAlgebraic (a : AlgebraicNumber)
  | ofTranscendental (t : TranscendentalNumber)

name: SymbolicCoord.typeOf
doc: 取符号坐标的类型。来源 `SymbolicCoord.typeOf`。
stmt:
def SymbolicCoord.typeOf : SymbolicCoord → SymbolicType
  | ofRational _ => .rational
  | ofQuadratic _ => .quadratic
  | ofAlgebraic _ => .algebraic
  | ofTranscendental _ => .transcendental

name: SymbolicCoord.promoteType
doc: 两个符号坐标的类型提升。来源 `SymbolicCoord.promoteType`。
stmt: def SymbolicCoord.promoteType (a b : SymbolicCoord) : SymbolicType
proof: SymbolicType.promote a.typeOf b.typeOf

name: promoteType_deterministic
doc: **(A)** 类型提升对坐标是对称的（`promoteType` 展开为 `max` 后即交换律）。
stmt:
theorem promoteType_deterministic (a b : SymbolicCoord) :
    a.promoteType b = b.promoteType a
proof:
by
  unfold SymbolicCoord.promoteType SymbolicType.promote
  exact max_comm _ _

name: Exactness
doc: 精确性标记。来源 `Exactness`。
stmt:
inductive Exactness where
  | exact
  | approx
  deriving DecidableEq

name: TrustColor
doc: 信任色（五级，用于电路断路器）。来源 `TrustColor`。
stmt:
inductive TrustColor where
  | green
  | blue
  | amber
  | yellow
  | red
  deriving DecidableEq

                                                    
                                                               
instance : LinearOrder TrustColor
proof:
LinearOrder.lift' (fun c => match c with
    | .green => (0 : ℕ) | .blue => 1 | .amber => 2 | .yellow => 3 | .red => 4)
    (by intro a b h; cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all)

name: BIT_CUTOFF_THRESHOLD
doc: 比特数上限阈值。来源 `BIT_CUTOFF_THRESHOLD`。
stmt: def BIT_CUTOFF_THRESHOLD : Nat

name: bitCount
doc: 整数的比特宽度（含符号位）。来源 `bitCount`。
stmt: def bitCount (z : Int) : Nat
proof:
if z = 0 then 0
  else if z > 0 then Nat.log2 (Int.toNat z) + 1
  else Nat.log2 (Int.toNat (-z)) + 1

name: RationalNumber.withinCircuitLimit
doc: 有理数是否在电路规模限制内。来源 `RationalNumber.withinCircuitLimit`。
stmt: def RationalNumber.withinCircuitLimit (r : RationalNumber) : Bool
proof: bitCount r.num ≤ BIT_CUTOFF_THRESHOLD && Nat.log2 r.den + 1 ≤ BIT_CUTOFF_THRESHOLD

name: AlgebraicNumber.withinCircuitLimit
doc: 代数数是否在电路规模限制内。来源 `AlgebraicNumber.withinCircuitLimit`。
stmt: def AlgebraicNumber.withinCircuitLimit (a : AlgebraicNumber) : Bool
proof: a.minimalPoly.all (fun c => bitCount c ≤ BIT_CUTOFF_THRESHOLD)

name: checkCircuitAndUpdateTrust
doc: 电路断路器：超限则降级信任色。来源 `checkCircuitAndUpdateTrust`。
stmt: def checkCircuitAndUpdateTrust (coord : TrustColor) (withinLimit : Bool) : TrustColor
proof:
if withinLimit then coord
  else
    match coord with
    | .green => .amber
    | .blue => .amber
    | c => c

name: permanentDegrade
doc: 连续失败后永久降级。来源 `permanentDegrade`。
stmt: def permanentDegrade (failCount : Nat) (current : TrustColor) : TrustColor
proof:
if failCount ≥ 3 then
    match current with
    | .green => .yellow
    | .blue => .yellow
    | .amber => .yellow
    | c => c
  else current

name: circuit_breaker_monotone
doc: **(A)** 断路器只会降低或保持信任色（单调不升）。
stmt:
theorem circuit_breaker_monotone (old new : TrustColor)
    (h : new = checkCircuitAndUpdateTrust old false) : new ≥ old
proof:
by
  subst h
  cases old <;> decide

name: permanent_degrade_monotone
doc: **(A)** 永久降级只会降低或保持信任色。
stmt:
theorem permanent_degrade_monotone (c : TrustColor) (n : Nat) (h : n ≥ 3) :
    permanentDegrade n c ≥ c
proof:
by
  unfold permanentDegrade
  simp [h]
  cases c <;> decide

name: RationalNumber.serialize
doc: 有理数序列化。来源 `RationalNumber.serialize`。
stmt: def RationalNumber.serialize (r : RationalNumber) : String
proof: toString r.num ++ "/" ++ toString r.den

name: QuadraticNumber.serialize
doc: 二次根式数序列化。来源 `QuadraticNumber.serialize`。
stmt: def QuadraticNumber.serialize (q : QuadraticNumber) : String
proof:
q.a.serialize ++ " + " ++ q.b.serialize ++ "*sqrt(" ++ toString q.n ++ ")"
